oes-sat-1.webp.zh: 在卫星图上，圣安东尼奥奥斯特机场（OES）与周围的干旱地表与裸地连成一片。
oes-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, Antoine de Saint Exupéry Airport (OES) blends into the surrounding dry ground and bare land.

oes-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 白色砖墙上写着圣埃克苏佩里机场和民航管理部门的字样，一群人正从绿松石门柱旁走过。
oes-chatgpt-01.webp.en: A white brick wall bears the words Aerodromo Saint A Exupery and the civil aviation authority, while a group of people walks past turquoise gate pillars.

oes-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 白色塔台配着绿色屋檐，与低矮的平房相连，门前几棵树，蓝天上有丝丝云。
oes-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A white control tower with green trim connects to a low terminal building, with small trees in front and wispy cloud across the blue sky.

oes-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 铺着碎石的红褐色跑道空无一人，两旁长满枯黄的草，平坦的地平线一直延伸到天边。
oes-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An empty reddish gravel runway stretches away between dry grass, its flat horizon meeting a pale blue sky.

oes-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 仰拍视角下，白色方形塔台的玻璃观察室向阳而立，绿瓦屋檐下是白色的砖墙。
oes-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Shot from below, the glass cab of a white control tower rises against a clear blue sky above a green-tiled roof and brick walls.

oes-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 白绿涂装的双发涡桨公务机停在停机坪上，机头朝向镜头，背景是成排的绿树。
oes-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A white twin turboprop with a green stripe is parked nose-on to the camera on the tarmac, with a line of trees behind it.

oes-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 这是一张网络地图截图，红色定位标记落在圣安东尼奥奥斯特的航空俱乐部，旁边是海湾保护区。
oes-chatgpt-06.webp.en: This is a map screenshot with a red pin marking the Aeroclub San Antonio Oeste, beside a bay nature reserve and a coastal road.
